newsitem.title: FRANCE: SIA to increase ex-Paris cargo rates from April 1.
newsitem.headline: SIA to increase ex-Paris cargo rates from April 1.

text.p: Singapore Airlines (SIA), said it will increase ex-Paris cargo rates to Singapore and selected onward destinations by around five percent, effective next April 1.
SIA last increased its ex-Paris rates in October 1996.

David Lim, SIA s London-based regional cargo manager, Europe, told Reuters in an interview that SIA planned to introduce two, additional weekly Boeing 747-200 freighter flights between Paris/CDG to Singapore, in conjunction with Air France, effective end-March 1997, instead of one as initially planned.
This will take the number of weekly freighter flights on the route to five.
The upgrade of the Paris-Singapore service was down to the buoyant level of outbound and inbound traffic and strong demand forecasts for 1997, he said.
